verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a data-export feature or open export formats. The open-source repo, which can be cloned and self-hosted on macOS, Linux or WSL, plus a public OpenAPI spec do give an indirect exit path from the hosted service. missing for 10: a documented export of collections, synced entities and embeddings, defined open export formats, any migration-off or offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on confirmation that data can be fully extracted.
